description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2023: Comparative Study on Cross Laminated Timber (CLT) and Light Wood Framing (LWF) is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Joel Conte, University of California San Diego (ucsd.edu). This paper explains and compares cross laminated timber (CLT) and light wood framing (LWF) construction. These construction methods are important because CLT is starting to spread throughout North America while LWF has been the typical method when creating structures. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-p7sp-h429. Keywords: NHERI LHPOST6; CLT; Light Wood Framing. Published 2023-09-01. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
